# Feature: Q&A framework: verifier gate for mechanic sanity checks

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Give every mechanic-sanity-check feature a testing bar that proves the mechanic works in real play, not just that code passes (plans/qa-framework/PLAN.md).

## User Story

As a reviewer, I want every mechanic feature to carry recorded agent sessions replay-verified by a script, so broken mechanics cannot reach review on unit tests alone.

## High-Level Use Case

Agent records agent sessions in the teaching room, runs python3 tools/verify_mechanic_qa.py <feature-id>, pastes the report in the qa-verification task; verifier exit 0 is required before in_review.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- qa is a first-class task kind.
- Verifier requires agent won + naive + edge sessions, deterministic replay, header linkage, screenshots, rule -> evidence table.
- Node-only scripted logs do not satisfy the gate.

## Edge Cases & Rules

- Human-only sessions never count as agent evidence.
- Tampered session (step count / digest) fails.
- Empty input log must not reach won.

## UI / Feedback

Board shows a qa chip on qa tasks.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

None.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] verify_mechanic_qa.py + tests green
- [ ] agent-workflow/template gate amended
- [ ] pilot on mech-81-push-block recorded on its qa-verification task

## Out of Scope

Retro-running all 73 mechanics in this feature; each gets its own qa-verification task.
